results.title: Playback
results.overview: When a mysterious camcorder appears in their home, a couple's buried sins manifest in terrifying ways.

results.title: Black Eyes
results.overview: In Mongolia's timeless Altai Mountains, 13-year-old Kharakoz embodies a captivating blend of ancestral traditions and modern influences. As she learns the ancient art of eagle-hunting, the film delves into the powerful ripple effect of passing this sacred knowledge to girls.

results.title: RYUJI ⻯⼆
results.overview: The eternal legend etched into Japanese film history, rises again. (remake of the 1983 eponymous film).

results.title: Hex
results.overview: Three young Norwegian women form a coven and start the black metal band Witch Club Satan. Before they know it, they are playing at major international festivals, but the battle has only just begun.

results.title: #Cult
results.overview: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

results.title: Kärlek och andra diagnoser
results.overview: A romantic dramedy about a young couple on the Autism Spectrum who try to answer life's most difficult question: What the hell do you do when you fall in love?

results.title: Flow Vision
results.overview: There is something that has always excited Ambroise in Downhill Skateboarding: it's those moments you experience two or three times in a season or even in your life. He has only experienced this a few times in his life while skating, so he decided to skate the most challenging road in Europe to immerse himself in this mental state — the flow state.

results.title: Redwood Diaries
results.overview: When strange entries begin appearing in her diary written in handwriting that isn't hers, new student Evie Quinn is pulled into a chilling mystery as the messages reveal secrets, predict impossible events, and point toward a truth someone has desperately tried to bury.

results.title: When a Witness Recants
results.overview: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

results.title: Jaunt
results.overview: In a stark warehouse office, Justice is weighed down by mounting deadlines and an endless to-do list. But every day, he finds escape in a one-hour ritual that reignites his spirit.

results.title: All About the Money
results.overview: A son of one of America’s wealthiest families creates a communist revolutionary base in rural Massachusetts as a means of disrupting the capitalist system he grew up in, but has now come to despise. It’s the starting point of an astonishing journey.

results.title: The Wrath
results.overview: Newlyweds and documentary filmmakers Devyn and Ben travel to Thailand to capture the legend of Mae Nak—a spirit said to manipulate the living through love and rage.

results.title: Collision Course
results.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

results.title: Echoes of Motherhood
results.overview: The love and conflicts between mother and daughter, and between husband and wife. The final chapter of Nakagawa Ryutaro's trilogy, depicting the forms of love that endure through loss and rebirth.

results.title: You no Mashallah!
results.overview: Usman is a young undocumented immigrant who, like so many others, came to Europe in search of a better life. However, all Europe has to offer is a precarious existence. He lives in a heated apartment and works as a food delivery driver. In just 24 hours, the delicate balance that sustains him will be upended, forcing him to make a drastic decision to survive and, perhaps, continue pursuing his dream.

results.title: This Solitude
results.overview: Leo and Lorea have loved one another. Maybe they still do. But something in them has broken. After five years, their relationship is done. He looks after his sick father, trapped between responsibility and an emotional void that weighs him down. She, caught up in poorly-paid jobs and personal crises, tries to get her life back on track without really knowing where to begin. They are two bodies, tired and alone, pierced by their precarious situation, by unresolved issues, by the emotional legacy of a generation who always seem to come late to everything: to love, to stability, to maturity, to serenity, to personal satisfaction.

results.title: Dead Howling
results.overview: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

results.title: Phoenix Fury
results.overview: When Ewura-Ama, recently widowed, inherits Utopia Valley, a luxury resort tucked in the quiet hills of Ghana, her search for solitude is disrupted by the arrival of a high-profile guest. Their uneasy encounter stirs tensions that awaken secrets buried decades ago.
